Messages.Author: Nicx
Messages.Body:
Hi,

I would like to know about the special ability of Amelia, The blood
red tears: "After combat with Amelia, the opposing minion burns 1
blood or life."

If Amelia goes to torpor in a combat, does the opposing minion burn
1 blood? Does the special ability is still valid? Thanks!

Nicolas Savard

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


All special abilities function from torpor unless card text specifically
requires "ready".
